channel.name: BBC Two NL
channel.title: Live: London Marathon
channel.desc: Live coverage of the London Marathon continues as the 59,000 runners begin to reach the end of their 26.2-mile journey across the capital, each of them with their own unique reason for taking part in this year's event. Gabby Logan and a team of reporters are with them every step of the way as they reveal the uplifting and inspiring stories of many of the charity runners taking part.
